notes:
## New features
- The Contours side panel is rebuilt. Each tab puts the controls you use most at the top, and simple settings fit on one line:
  - **Result:** time slices, sources (with counts) and screening, plus a one-line grid summary. Scenario and slice are chosen in the top bar only.
  - **Contours:** colours, levels (with − / + steppers), method, labels, fill and lines, shape. The band table opens on demand.
  - **Map:** basemap layers, building-name size, colour-by-level and red-line outlines.
  - **Sheet:** one Style picker at the top that sets the whole look (Studio, Planning report, Minimal, Client presentation, Monochrome print, Classic) and replaces the separate style and panel presets. Quick switches cover the north arrow, scale bar, neatline and side panel, followed by the side panel's contents. Detailed typography is still available below. Sheet details is removed; rename a sheet from its menu.
- The neatline can have rounded corners (Sheet › Corner radius, square by default). The radius is saved with the sheet and kept when you change style.
- The Run list shows only the runs for the scenario, time slice and view chosen in the top bar, labelled by date (latest and out-of-date runs are marked).
- Right-click the AURIS icon in the Dock to open one of your five most recent projects directly, or start a new one.
- Map alignment: geo-referenced maps (Google, OS, OSM captures) have Align E/N controls in the layer popover. Use them when an aerial sits a metre or two off OS mapping. That offset comes from the imagery itself; AURIS's OS grid conversion is correct. Only the map moves; coordinates and terrain keep the true grid.
- Map only: a new toolbar button next to Receptor hides every object and the inspector so you can see or export just the basemap. Click it again to bring everything back.
- Red-line outlines in the composer: Map › Red-line outlines › Draw outline. Click corners, then double-click or press Enter to close. Outlines are saved with the project, appear on exported sheets, and can be shown or hidden with one click.
- Defaults before drawing: right-click any object › Use as Default for New … and everything you draw next of that type starts with its properties (roads include their CRTN traffic, speed and surface). The Building tool defaults also gain reflections, absorption, façade receptors and label options.
- Sports courts:
  - Add glass rebound walls: creates both padel end enclosures as screens at FIP heights (3 m back walls, returning 2 m at 3 m and 2 m at 2 m along each side), as CadnaA and VDI 3770 practice requires.
  - New library entry: Padel court – DataKustik 2025, LWA 97 dB per court. This is the VDI 3770 data used by CadnaA 2026.
  - Courts now emit at 2.0 m (padel and tennis) or 1.5 m (pickleball) instead of 0.1 m when the height was left at the default.
- Opening a project shows real progress: how much of the file has been read (useful when iCloud is still downloading it), then each restore step with its timing. The dialog stays until the workspace is ready.

## Changes
- Court setup now comes before the noise input, so you choose the court and then its level. Choosing Sports Court fills in Padel markings, the actual court size and the source height.
- Court markings are dark red instead of black. The short centre-line extension past the service lines is the 20 cm projection required by FIP rules.
- Receptor and source size +/− buttons step by 0.5 m.
- Opening a project no longer freezes for a moment as the progress dialog closes.

## Bug fixes
- Contour calculation failed with "The model has changed since this grid was calculated" even when nothing had changed (introduced in 0.18.7). Two causes, both fixed:
  - The check compared two different kinds of fingerprint.
  - Projects with imported terrain renumbered their terrain points on every load, so a calculation's own copy of the model never matched.
- 3D view: blocky "static" over the ground and roofs while moving the camera. The shadow filter was too narrow at the navigation shadow resolution.
- 3D view: the noisy ambient-occlusion effect that 0.18.1 turned off while navigating was being switched back on by the lighting settings.
- Railway tracks broke apart at bends, leaving a gap on the outside and an overshoot on the inside. Rails and sleepers now run continuously through corners.
- Alt-drag duplicate did nothing unless the object was already selected. It now works on any object, with a ghost preview, for point, line and area sources, receptors, roads, railways, barriers, berms, buildings, ground regions and attenuation areas.
- Duplicating area sources (including sports courts) and attenuation areas silently created nothing. Berms and ground regions couldn't be duplicated at all. Advanced Duplicate had the same gaps.
- Sports courts:
  - Switching a court back to Generic Polygon didn't stick.
  - Markings couldn't be changed while a court size was chosen.
